sentences.content: It’s almost the Spring Festival.
sentences.english: It's almost the Spring Festival
sentences.chinese: 春节快到了。

sentences.content: Can we go to Hainan for the holiday, Dad?
sentences.english: Can we go to Hainan for the holiday , Dad ?
sentences.chinese: 爸爸，我们假期能去海南吗？

sentences.content: Not this time.
sentences.english: Not this time
sentences.chinese: 这次不行。

sentences.content: We’re going to your mum’s hometown!
sentences.english: We're going to your mum's hometown !
sentences.chinese: 我们要去你妈妈的家乡！

sentences.content: Soon the day of our family trip came.
sentences.english: Soon the day of our family trip came
sentences.chinese: 我们家庭旅行的日子很快就到了。

sentences.content: We got up very early in the morning to catch the train.
sentences.english: We got up very early in the morning to catch the train
sentences.chinese: 我们一大早就起床去赶火车了。

sentences.content: The train journey took more than seven hours,
sentences.english: The train journey took more than seven hours
sentences.chinese: 这趟火车旅程耗时超过七小时。

sentences.content: and then we changed to a bus to get to my grandparents’ village in the evening.
sentences.english: and then we changed to a bus to get to my grandparents' village in the evening
sentences.chinese: 然后我们换乘巴士，在傍晚时分抵达了我祖父母居住的村庄。

sentences.content: At the end of the road, I saw Grandpa and my little cousin standing in the cold wind waiting for us.
sentences.english: At the end of the road , I saw Grandpa and my little cousin standing in the cold wind waiting for us
sentences.chinese: 在路的尽头，我看见爷爷和小表弟站在寒风中等着我们。

sentences.content: We walked quickly to greet them.
sentences.english: We walked quickly to greet them
sentences.chinese: 我们快步上前迎接他们。

sentences.content: Grandpa helped us pull the heavy luggage into the house.
sentences.english: Grandpa helped us pull the heavy luggage into the house
sentences.chinese: 爷爷帮我们把沉重的行李拖进了屋里。

sentences.content: Ah, home again!
sentences.english: Ah , home again !
sentences.chinese: 啊，又回到家了！

sentences.content: Grandma, my aunt, and my uncle were busy cooking dinner in the kitchen.
sentences.english: Grandma , my aunt , and my uncle were busy cooking dinner in the kitchen
sentences.chinese: 奶奶、姑姑和叔叔正在厨房里忙着做晚饭。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

sentences.content: They were very happy to see us.
sentences.english: They were very happy to see us
sentences.chinese: 他们见到我们非常高兴。

sentences.content: After a little while, my parents went to the kitchen to help.
sentences.english: After a little while , my parents went to the kitchen to help
sentences.chinese: 过了一会儿，我的父母去厨房帮忙了。

sentences.content: Could you bring Wenwen her favourite snacks?
sentences.english: Could you bring Wenwen her favourite snacks ?
sentences.chinese: 你能给Wenwen带她最喜欢的零食吗？

sentences.content: I shared the snacks with my cousin and told Grandpa about school.
sentences.english: I shared the snacks with my cousin and told Grandpa about school
sentences.chinese: 我和表亲分享了零食，还跟爷爷讲了学校的事。

sentences.content: He was happy to hear I was doing well at school.
sentences.english: He was happy to hear I was doing well at school
sentences.chinese: 听说我在学校表现不错，他感到很高兴。

sentences.content: When dinner was ready, I asked, “Can I help?”
sentences.english: When dinner was ready , I asked ," Can I help ?"
sentences.chinese: 晚餐准备好时，我问道：“需要帮忙吗？”

sentences.content: You can set the table.
sentences.english: You can set the table
sentences.chinese: 你可以摆餐具了。

sentences.content: We then enjoyed all the delicious food.
sentences.english: We then enjoyed all the delicious food
sentences.chinese: 随后我们享用了所有美味佳肴。

sentences.content: Mm, the familiar taste of home!
sentences.english: Mm , the familiar taste of home !
sentences.chinese: 嗯，这熟悉的家常味道！

sentences.content: During the dinner, my uncle told us some jokes and we had a good laugh.
sentences.english: During the dinner , my uncle told us some jokes and we had a good laugh
sentences.chinese: 晚餐时，我的叔叔给我们讲了些笑话，逗得大家开怀大笑。

sentences.content: Several days later when we were leaving, Grandma held my hands and asked us,
sentences.english: Several days later when we were leaving , Grandma held my hands and asked us
sentences.chinese: 几天后我们即将离开时，奶奶握住我的手问道，

sentences.content: “Will you come home more often?”
sentences.english: " Will you come home more often ?"
sentences.chinese: 你会更常回家吗？

sentences.content: Mum nodded, with tears in her eyes.
sentences.english: Mum nodded , with tears in her eyes
sentences.chinese: 妈妈点了点头，眼里含着泪水。
